package.name: new_arm_ui
package.description: User interfaces for the new_arm: a Python CLI and a browser-based web UI. Both support two command modes -- (1) Cartesian goals planned through MoveIt (/compute_ik -> FollowJointTrajectory) and (2) raw joint jogs straight to the driver (/arm/joint_command). The web UI uses rclnodejs (the ROS 2 Node.js client) so the Node server is itself a ROS 2 node; no rosbridge needed. rclnodejs requires Node 18/20 LTS (does not build on Node 25).
